children: Samsung Electronics Co Ltd Sponsored GDR Pfd (KRX:005930) is balancing record profit forecasts and a 38% DRAM lead with TSMC-made NVHBM base dies for Nvidia and top smartphone share, while facing investor pressure over preferreds, share transfers to Jay Y. Lee and recent weak ADR performance.
: Samsung Electronics (005930) will have NVHBM base dies made on TSMC's 3nm process for Nvidia, marking its first TSMC-sourced HBM base‑die work; Samsung keeps making standard HBM in-house.
Buy: Samsung GDR Pfd; AI NAND Strength
: Goldman Sachs gave a Buy to Samsung Electronics Co Ltd Sponsored GDR Pfd (005930), citing strength in NAND flash and positioning in high-bandwidth flash for AI workloads versus peers.
: Samsung Electronics (005930) held roughly 38% of the global DRAM market in Q2 2026, with competitors at 25%, 24% and a rising player at ~10%.
: Samsung Electronics (005930) forecasted record quarterly operating profit of 107.4 trillion won; noted risk of margin pressure if competitors like CXMT disrupt memory supply.
: Palliser Capital urged Samsung Electronics (005930) to repurchase and cancel non-voting preferred shares, proposing US ADR issuance to fund buybacks and reduce the preferreds' discount.
: Samsung Electronics Co Ltd Sponsored GDR Pfd (005930) showed negative performance, cited by Korea’s main national pension fund as contributing to its recent investment losses.

: Samsung Electronics (005930) stayed the top smartphone vendor in Q3 2026 with a 23% share; shipments fell 3% year‑on‑year. Galaxy Z Fold8 demand and steady mid‑range component supply supported sales.
: Samsung Electronics (005930): Chairman Jay Y. Lee to receive about 11.16M shares from his mother, Hong Ra-hee, valued near 2.6 trillion won (~$1.9B).
